description: Source code implementing DNS utility functions for mDNS endpoints and HTTPS query name generation within the Chromium project.

methods.name: GetMdnsIPEndPoint
methods.description: Returns an IPEndPoint for the given multicast address literal.

methods.name: GetMdnsGroupEndPoint
methods.description: Returns an IPEndPoint for the mDNS multicast group based on address family.

methods.name: GetMdnsReceiveEndPoint
methods.description: Returns an IPEndPoint for receiving mDNS messages, platform-dependent.

methods.name: GetNameForHttpsQuery
methods.description: Generates a hostname for HTTPS queries based on scheme, port, and host.
